summary: Deleted secrets and keys can be recovered, and urgent fixes reach you within minutes.

fixes.title: Deleted secrets can be recovered
fixes.text: Deleted secrets and keys can be recovered during their retention period.

fixes.title: Security pack lists the updater's rights
fixes.text: The security pack lists the updater's rights.

fixes.title: Urgent fixes arrive within minutes
fixes.text: A fix marked urgent is now installed within minutes instead of at the next daily update. Other releases still wait for your installation's own update time.

fixes.title: Installation name is kept
fixes.text: Your installation keeps its name on the vendor portal, and a failed read never clears it.
